# Archive test fixtures

The RAR fixtures are decoded copies of the corresponding `.rar.uu` files from
[libarchive v3.7.2](https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/tree/v3.7.2/libarchive/test):

- `test_read_format_rar_windows.rar` (RAR4)
- `test_read_format_rar5_compressed.rar`
- `test_read_format_rar5_solid.rar`

They contain test data, not executables. Libarchive's BSD license is reproduced
in `LIBARCHIVE-LICENSE`.
